senses.zh_definition: 专名：泰米尔语电影《Puli》中由 Vijay 饰演的角色名 Marudheeran；尚无依据将其列为正式马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: A proper name borne by a character played by Vijay in the Tamil film Puli; not verified as a standard Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas bagi watak yang dilakonkan oleh Vijay dalam filem Tamil Puli; bukan takrif kata umum bahasa Melayu yang disahkan oleh DBP.
senses.nuances: 正常行文应写作 Marudheeran。输入包没有 DBP 释义，因此不能据其排名宣称该词已获官方收录。以下为专名的示范组合，不代表经过语料统计的高频搭配。角色身份见 [Apple TV《Puli》](https://tv.apple.com/us/movie/puli/umc.cmc.5lb5qci6otttqhe7il4n4zc6y)。

etymology.historical_story: Marudheeran is attested as a character name in the 2015 Tamil fantasy film Puli. Its appearance in Malay discussion can therefore reflect references to Tamil cinema rather than adoption as a Malay common word. This evidence establishes a cultural referent, but does not establish the name's original etymology or pronunciation. [Film listing](https://tv.apple.com/us/movie/puli/umc.cmc.5lb5qci6otttqhe7il4n4zc6y).
